mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.appoint_no, a.visitor_id, v.name AS visitorName, v.phone AS visitorPhone, a.host_id, u.real_name AS hostName, u.dept_name AS hostDept, a.visit_type, a.purpose, a.expected_arrive, a.expected_leave, a.status, a.approved_by, a.approved_at, a.reject_reason, a.reschedule_from, a.created_at, pc.code AS passCode, pc.status AS passCodeStatus FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.host_id = u.id LEFT JOIN pass_code pc ON a.id = pc.appointment_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE status = 'CHECKED_IN' AND expected_leave IS NOT NULL AND expected_leave < #{now}
